notes.comment:
This line applies the derive macros Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize to the SessionInfo struct. Debug enables pretty-printing for logging. Clone allows cheap copies. Serialize/Deserialize let serde automatically convert SessionInfo to/from JSON in .lines.json — the #[serde(rename = "sessionId")] on the field below maps session_id to the camelCase JSON key.
SessionInfo is persisted inside LinesFile and sent over the HTTP API, so it needs both Serialize (for writing to .lines.json and HTTP responses) and Deserialize (for reading back). Clone is used when the GUI reads the persisted session on startup. Debug is for developer convenience.

notes.comment: nice, could you give me more details?

handle_get_notes is the GET /session-api/notes endpoint. It loads .lines.json from disk via notes_store::load(), serializes the entire LinesFile struct (version, revision, session, notes) to JSON using serde_json::to_value, and returns it as the HTTP response body. If serialization fails it returns an error JSON. This is the primary endpoint AI CLIs call to fetch all user review notes.
This is a read-only endpoint — it does not modify .lines.json. The response includes the full LinesFile structure so AI agents can see both the notes and the session metadata (sessionId, cli, serverUrl) in one request. The revision counter in the response can be used for polling to detect changes.

notes.comment:
This is the server_url field inside the persisted session object. It stores the HTTP server URL of the connected AI CLI (opencode running on port 4096). When the user presses S on a note, lazygitrs reads this URL and pushes the review prompt directly to the running opencode TUI via POST /tui/append-prompt + POST /tui/submit-prompt — no new process spawned. This field is populated when the AI CLI registers with {"action":"register","serverUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:4096"}.
The server_url enables the inline push workflow. Without it, lazygitrs falls back to SSE or spawning a subprocess. Persisting it to .lines.json means it survives lazygitrs restarts — the GUI restores it on startup so the TUI push keeps working even after a restart.
